j.vcoModIn.lfo@init: The LFO takes the LFO’s place as the pitch modulation of both VCOs, up to an octave either way at full strength. The LFO no longer moves the pitch, but it still drives LFO OUT 1, LFO OUT 2 and pulse-width modulation.
j.vcoModIn.lfo@mod.vco1Off=true: The LFO takes the LFO’s place as the pitch modulation of VCO 2 only (VCO 1 MOD OFF is on), up to an octave either way at full strength. The LFO no longer moves the pitch, but it still drives LFO OUT 1, LFO OUT 2 and pulse-width modulation.
